message: Congratulations! Pre-approved personal loan of ₹5,00,000 sanctioned at 1% interest. No CIBIL score or income proof needed. Pay mandatory file processing fee of ₹1,999 to bank escrow via UPI to release funds.
explanation: Regulated banks and NBFCs deduct processing charges directly from the loan disbursal amount; they NEVER demand upfront advance payments via personal UPI handles.
redFlags: Unsolicited loan pre-approval without credit check
Requires upfront processing fee via UPI before disbursal

choices.text: Transfer ₹1,999 processing fee via UPI to unlock loan
choices.feedback: Advance Fee Trap! After receiving ₹1,999, they will demand GST fees, insurance fees, and never send a loan.

choices.text: Reject and report; legitimate lenders never demand advance UPI fees to disburse loans
choices.feedback: Spot on! Upfront advance fees for loans are an absolute hallmark of loan fraud.

choices.text: Send Aadhaar and PAN documents to negotiate a lower fee
choices.feedback: Identity Theft Risk! Fraudsters use your KYC documents to take fraudulent SIM cards or loans in your name.
